name: CoreUI Icons
summary: Open-source icon set of 1,500+ icons in SVG, PNG and webfont formats, with React, Vue and Angular packages.
description: CoreUI Free Icons ships more than 1,500 icons as SVG sprites and symbols, PNG and webfont files for use in web and mobile products. Install from CDN, npm or Yarn, or clone the repo; separate framework packages wrap the set for React, Vue and Angular. A paid CoreUI Icons PRO set adds more icons.
contains: 1,500+ icons in SVG, PNG and webfont formats
linear (cil-), brand (cib-) and flag (cif-) icon sets
CDN, npm and Yarn installation; SVG sprites and SVG symbols usage docs
separate official packages for React, Vue and Angular
licenses: MIT (code), SIL OFL 1.1 (fonts), CC BY 4.0 (icons)
paid CoreUI Icons PRO set alongside the free one
